query: Advertise the VLAN 110 subnet (10.110.2.0/24) from L2.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - BGP-E-04
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo
  tasks:

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety pre-check: L2 must be AS 65002
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify SONiC-VS-2 (L2) is running AS 65002
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_bgp_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l2_bgp_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'local AS number 65002' not in l2_bgp_precheck.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety pre-check: BGP TCP session must be Established.
    # Do NOT use "show ip bgp summary" for this check because
    # "(Policy)" can appear while the TCP session itself is Established.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2-S2 BGP TCP session is Established
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_s2_session_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l2_s2_session_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in l2_s2_session_precheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety pre-check: VLAN110 subnet must already exist on L2.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2 has 10.110.2.0/24 before advertising
      raw: ip route show 10.110.2.0/24
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_vlan110_route_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l2_vlan110_route_precheck.rc != 0
        or '10.110.2.0/24' not in l2_vlan110_route_precheck.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # REAL CHANGE:
    # Add outbound policy and advertise VLAN110 from L2.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure L2 to advertise 10.110.2.0/24 to S2
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10"
        -c "exit"
        -c "router bgp 65002"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast"
        -c "neighbor 10.2.2.1 route-map PERMIT-ALL out"
        -c "network 10.110.2.0/24"
        -c "exit-address-family"
        -c "exit"
        -c "exit"
        -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      ignore_errors: true

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY immediately after the real change.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2 running-config contains VLAN110 advertisement
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_runcfg_verify
      failed_when: >-
        l2_runcfg_verify.rc != 0
        or 'network 10.110.2.0/24' not in l2_runcfg_verify.stdout
        or 'neighbor 10.2.2.1 route-map PERMIT-ALL out' not in l2_runcfg_verify.stdout
        or 'route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10' not in l2_runcfg_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify the route exists in L2's BGP table.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2 BGP table contains 10.110.2.0/24
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp 10.110.2.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_bgp_route_verify
      until: >-
        l2_bgp_route_verify.rc == 0
        and '10.110.2.0/24' in l2_bgp_route_verify.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      failed_when: >-
        l2_bgp_route_verify.rc != 0
        or '10.110.2.0/24' not in l2_bgp_route_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify L2 is actually advertising the route to S2.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2 advertises 10.110.2.0/24 to S2
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.1 advertised-routes"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_adv_to_s2_verify
      until: >-
        l2_adv_to_s2_verify.rc == 0
        and '10.110.2.0/24' in l2_adv_to_s2_verify.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      failed_when: >-
        l2_adv_to_s2_verify.rc != 0
        or '10.110.2.0/24' not in l2_adv_to_s2_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify S2 received the route.
    # S2's neighbor corresponding to L2 is 10.2.2.0.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify S2 received 10.110.2.0/24 from L2
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp 10.110.2.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_bgp_route_verify
      until: >-
        s2_bgp_route_verify.rc == 0
        and '10.110.2.0/24' in s2_bgp_route_verify.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      failed_when: >-
        s2_bgp_route_verify.rc != 0
        or '10.110.2.0/24' not in s2_bgp_route_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify S2-L2 BGP session remains Established.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify S2-L2 BGP session remains Established
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.0" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_l2_session_verify
      failed_when: >-
        s2_l2_session_verify.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in s2_l2_session_verify.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final output.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Display L2 advertisement result
      debug:
        var: l2_adv_to_s2_verify.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"

    - name: Display S2 received route
      debug:
        var: s2_bgp_route_verify.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
